items.title: Trusted by people of the Greater Toronto Area

blocks.text: Carpet Removal Service The GTA Actually Relies On

c: Most people who’ve tried removing carpet themselves will tell you the same thing: the carpet isn’t even the hard part. A single room can take hours. A whole floor can wreck a weekend. For GTA homeowners and landlords managing turnovers, renovation timelines, or estate clearouts, a professional
isn’t a luxury — it’s the smarter call.

We offer same-day and next-day availability in most GTA areas, pricing confirmed upfront before we lift a single corner, and disposal handled responsibly through recycling channels wherever possible. Give us a call and we’ll handle the rest.

blocks.text: Book Your Carpet Removal Today — Fully Managed, Floor To Floor

c: handles everything — lifting, rolling, cutting where needed, hauling, and responsible disposal — at a price confirmed upfront before we start. Whether it’s a single room, a full house, or a staircase job in a Scarborough rental property, we leave your floors genuinely clear and ready for whatever comes next.
Our fully licensed and insured crew works carefully through every room — protecting baseboards, doorframes, and adjacent flooring throughout the process.
Ready to clear those floors? Call us now at +1 647 922 5865 or book online at LiveJunkFree.ca.

b: Easy Booking by Phone or Online

blocks.text: Professional Carpet Removal Service In The GTA — What Sets Live Junk Free Apart

b: Disposed Of Responsibly, Not Just Hauled Away:

c: Carpet and underlay contain recoverable fibre materials that recycling facilities can process — we prioritize these routes over general waste wherever possible. What can’t be recycled is disposed of through proper licensed channels. We take disposal seriously on every GTA job, not just the ones that make it convenient.

b: Your Price Is Confirmed Before We Start:

c: We quote every carpet removal job on-site, after seeing the actual space and scope. {{fact:taxNote}}. {{fact:pricingIntro.extra}} What we agree on before we start is what appears on your invoice.
